messages.author: b1fc98ae704fc25b
messages.subject: Using GG Plot with SAPUI5
parts:
Hello,
 
I wanted to know if it is possible to use the GG Plot library and in particular I am looking for this correlation graph for use on web - i.e. using JavaScript / HTML5.
 
It is possible that the plot data is taken from R but I have the need to visualize this via a webpage (not R Studio) so others can see it and I am struggling to understand how to emulate the GG Plot correlation graph on a web based solution:
 
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/15470463/how-to-create-faceted-correlation-plot-using-ggplot - this includes the line of best fit and shaded grey area.
 
I am using SAP UI5 which has the ability to add 3rd party libraries / extensibility - it's basically a HTML5 / JavaScript set of libraries but it doesn't have this type of visualization.
 
Thanks!
Raheel

messages.author: 4f04313c0a6b0f2f
messages.subject: Re: Using GG Plot with SAPUI5
parts:
If your objective is to just display that output from ggplot2 to a webpage to share with the public, then you'll have to use knitr (http://yihui.name/knitr/) to convert the code from a R markdown file to html and share that html file. Raw R code can also be compiled using knitr to create web pages.(It is a single click from within  R-Studio.)  For example, the data and code from that stackoverflow discussion could be combined to produce the page at this link:  https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/56796392/tempforggplot2mailinglist.html

Any knitr related questions are best directed at its mailing list. 

Best,
Vivek
